frame_metadata.gps_note: Camera had no location permission on this visit. Venue is established by the bookend frames IMG_1287 (entrance board, 15:00) and IMG_1318 (exterior, 15:50) and by shot order, not by GPS. Fixed on the phone the same evening; expect GPS from the next visit onward.

accession_note: There is no accession number anywhere on the wall because the work is NOT MCNY's. It is lent from the NYC Health + Hospitals Arts in Medicine Collection. §4.3's venue→accession→venue-catalog path fails structurally here, not because the label is poor. See D17.

internal_contradiction.exhibition_text_says: fifteen of the panels were conserved
internal_contradiction.resolution: Both are true: sixteen as painted, fifteen surviving conservation. A naive extractor reading two numbers for 'number of panels' sees a conflict. The honest model needs extent-as-made and extent-extant as separate facts.

traps.dash_flattening: Vision returned every en dash and nearly every em dash as U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS. '1896–1960' reads '1896-1960', '1938–1940' reads '1938-1940'. One em dash in the Spanish text survived as U+2014, so the flattening is INCONSISTENT within a single photograph. EDTF conversion therefore cannot key off dash type — it must key off pattern. See D19.
traps.decorative_lettering: The painted caption inside the artwork is hand-lettered and OCRs badly: 'Come Ablice!' for 'Come Alice!', "Ule'd" for "We'd". Confirms D15 — the work photo yields text, and that text is unreliable.
traps.rotation_is_fine: Two photographs were 90° rotated. Vision read them correctly with no preprocessing. Rotation is NOT a difficulty for this pipeline.
